svg.title: Level 2 overlay - Road Service
svg.desc: Road Service layer based on official Rijkswaterstaat NWB Wegen geometry, aligned to the Level 1 Netherlands SVG.
svg.metadata: Source: PDOK / Rijkswaterstaat NWB - Wegen OGC API, collection wegvakken, CC0 1.0. Filter: wegbehsrt=R (Rijksbeheer), route letter A-derived road-number set, functional-road-class frc=0, geometry simplified for presentation scale. Generated 2026-05-10.
